title: N170 connected-agent handoff v1
description: A private, sender-supplied JSON packet. It is not a source attestation. Semantic date, ordering, coverage, precision, and financial support checks are performed by parseAgentHandoff. Empty observations permit an honest blocked response.

tools.description: Names the sender claims it actually called; empty when no retrieval occurred. Not proof of MCP execution or permissions.

retrieved_at.description: Untrusted sender-reported retrieval time, not independent timestamp evidence. Null means no retrieval was performed and blocks calculation readiness.

account_scope.description: Public account alias/scope. Do not include actual account identifiers.

pagination.description: Sender claim, never independent completeness evidence.

flow_timing.description: interval_end asserts timing of EVERY actual external flow, including offsetting flows; zero net amounts do not establish absence. Owner must review. Intraperiod/unknown blocks readiness.

source_ref.description: Private reference into retained tool output; not authentication evidence. No credentials or account identifiers.

observations.description: Unique ascending dates; at least two observations and exact requested boundaries required for readiness. Never invent NAV, source references or zero flows. Use [] if no complete observations exist.

mapping.description: Private field paths explaining source mapping. Use 'Unavailable' for a blocked no-data packet; never fabricate a tool path.

decimal.description: Exact plain decimal string, <=18 fractional places, magnitude <=10^15. No exponents, grouping separators, currency symbols, null or JSON numbers. Numerical support is checked separately; nonpositive NAV blocks calculation.
